Worktrees deliberately do NOT get copies — the wrapper covers them, and syncing 64 of them was churn for no gain.
//paths: Relative to $HOME. Targets that do not exist on this machine are skipped, so the same list is valid across machines. Additional private targets come from CODEX_AGENT_SKILL_TARGETS (colon-separated, $HOME-relative) so no internal repo name is committed to this public repo.
//notinhere: slopweaver is deliberately NOT a target. It documents how to LOAD this plugin rather than carrying a competing copy of the skill — one door means one skill, and a second SKILL.md anywhere is a second door Claude can trigger.
